target: Classify the proposed predecision restriction-service contract and test whether service cardinality creates a resource beyond the supplied SAT decider.
quantifiers: For every language L, total uniform compiler R, and exact decider A for L, construct a coordinate evaluator for S_x(q)=1[R(x,q) in L] and account for coordinate, polynomial-batch, compact-program, and explicit-table contracts.
model: Uniform deterministic ordinary indexed CNF with read-only source where declared; explicit residual/output writing unless a separately charged accessor is supplied.

barrier_audit.relativization: The service simulation relativizes; it supplies no nonrelativizing hinge.
barrier_audit.algebrization: Algebraic-oracle access only strengthens the evaluator; no nonalgebrizing hinge is supplied.
barrier_audit.natural_proofs: No large constructive circuit property is used.
barrier_audit.cross_domain: Cell-probe bounds are model-matched only after a forced SAT-to-data-structure compiler, which remains OPEN.
barrier_audit.post_quantum: Schur-square, quadratic-relation, Hilbert/syzygy, and collision-entropy transfers fail without a forced same-execution object; worst-case/average-case and special-soundness remain analogies only.

corpus_reconciliation.new_relative_to_root_main: A restriction service must be split into coordinate, polynomial-batch, explicit-table, and preprocessing/query contracts; only the last two add requirements, and they change the task or model.
corpus_reconciliation.duplication: RT-0006 already supplied the source-plus-program idea; LB-0009 adds exact time/space and batch ledgers plus the four-contract theorem.
corpus_reconciliation.retired: Service-coordinate cardinality as a generic hardness measure.
corpus_reconciliation.stale_or_overstated: PREDECISION-SERVICE1 is underspecified unless its exact output and preprocessing/query contract is fixed.
